use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use crate::file_searcher::{FileSearcher, SearchMatch};
use regex::Regex;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum InputMode {
    Search,
    Replace,
    List,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FileResult {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub matches: Vec<SearchMatch>,
    pub selected: bool,
    pub expanded: bool,
}

pub struct App {
    pub project_root: PathBuf,
    pub search_input: String,
    pub replace_input: String,
    pub input_mode: InputMode,
    pub search_mode: SearchMode,
    pub replace_mode: ReplaceMode,
    pub file_results: Vec<FileResult>,
    pub selected_file_idx: usize,
    pub selected_match_idx: Option<usize>,
    pub dirty: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SearchMode {
    Simple,
    Regex,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ReplaceMode {
    Simple,
    Regex,
}

impl App {
    pub fn new(project_root: PathBuf) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
        Ok(Self {
            project_root,
            search_input: String::new(),
            replace_input: String::new(),
            input_mode: InputMode::Search,
            search_mode: SearchMode::Simple,
            replace_mode: ReplaceMode::Simple,
            file_results: Vec::new(),
            selected_file_idx: 0,
            selected_match_idx: None,
            dirty: true,
        })
    }

    pub fn perform_search(&mut self) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        if self.search_input.is_empty() {
            self.file_results.clear();
            return Ok(());
        }

        let searcher = FileSearcher::new(self.project_root.clone())?;
        let matches = match self.search_mode {
            SearchMode::Simple => searcher.search_simple(&self.search_input)?,
            SearchMode::Regex => searcher.search_regex(&self.search_input)?,
        };

        // Group matches by file
        let mut files_map: std::collections::HashMap<PathBuf, Vec<SearchMatch>> = std::collections::HashMap::new();
        for m in matches {
            files_map.entry(m.file.clone())
                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)
                .push(m);

            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
            .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_file())
        {

            }

            if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) {

                    if let Some(pos) = line.find(pattern) {
                        results.push(SearchMatch {
                            file: path.to_path_buf(),
                            line_number: line_num + 1,
                            column: pos,
                            matched_text: pattern.to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(results)
    }

    pub fn search_regex(&self, pattern: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<SearchMatch>> {
        let regex = Regex::new(pattern)?;
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        for entry in WalkDir::new(&self.root)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())

                if matches!(name_str, "node_modules" | "target" | ".git" | ".venv" | "dist" | "build") {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        false
    }

use ratatui::{
    backend::Backend,
    layout::{Constraint, Direction, Layout, Rect},
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
    text::{Line, Span},
    widgets::{Block, Borders, List, ListItem, Paragraph, Tabs, Wrap},
    Frame,
};
use crate::app::{App, InputMode, SearchMode, ReplaceMode};

pub fn draw<B: Backend>(f: &mut Frame<B>, app: &App) {
    let size = f.size();

    // Create main layout: left side and right side (preview)
    let chunks = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Percentage(30),
            Constraint::Percentage(70),
        ])
        .split(size);

    let left_area = chunks[0];
    let preview_area = chunks[1];

    // Left side: Search, Replace, and Results
    let left_chunks = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Length(3),
            Constraint::Length(3),
            Constraint::Min(5),
        ])
        .split(left_area);

    let search_area = left_chunks[0];
    let replace_area = left_chunks[1];
    let list_area = left_chunks[2];

    // Draw Search box
    let search_block = Block::default()
        .title(" Search ")
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .style(if app.input_mode == InputMode::Search {
            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)
        } else {
            Style::default()
        });

    let search_mode_str = match app.search_mode {
        SearchMode::Simple => "Simple",
        SearchMode::Regex => "Regex",
    };
    
    let search_block = search_block.title_alignment(ratatui::layout::Alignment::Right)
        .title(format!(" {} ", search_mode_str));

    let search_paragraph = Paragraph::new(app.search_input.as_str())
        .block(search_block)
        .style(Style::default());
    f.render_widget(search_paragraph, search_area);

    // Draw cursor in search if active
    if app.input_mode == InputMode::Search {
        let cursor_x = search_area.x + app.search_input.len() as u16 + 1;
        let cursor_y = search_area.y + 1;
        f.set_cursor(cursor_x, cursor_y);
    }

    // Draw Replace box
    let replace_block = Block::default()
        .title(" Replace ")
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .style(if app.input_mode == InputMode::Replace {
            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)
        } else {
            Style::default()
        });

    let replace_mode_str = match app.replace_mode {
        ReplaceMode::Simple => "Simple",
        ReplaceMode::Regex => "Regex",
    };

    let replace_block = replace_block.title_alignment(ratatui::layout::Alignment::Right)
        .title(format!(" {} ", replace_mode_str));

    let replace_paragraph = Paragraph::new(app.replace_input.as_str())
        .block(replace_block)
        .style(Style::default());
    f.render_widget(replace_paragraph, replace_area);

    // Draw cursor in replace if active
    if app.input_mode == InputMode::Replace {
        let cursor_x = replace_area.x + app.replace_input.len() as u16 + 1;
        let cursor_y = replace_area.y + 1;
        f.set_cursor(cursor_x, cursor_y);
    }

    // Draw Results List
    let result_block = Block::default()
        .title(" Result List ")
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .style(if app.input_mode == InputMode::List {
            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)
        } else {
            Style::default()
        });

    let items: Vec<ListItem> = app.file_results.iter().map(|file_result| {
        let count = file_result.matches.len();
        let path_str = file_result.path
            .strip_prefix(&app.project_root)
            .unwrap_or(&file_result.path)
            .display()
            .to_string();
        
        let style = if app.file_results.iter().position(|f| f.path == file_result.path) == Some(app.selected_file_idx) {
            Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray)
        } else {
            Style::default()
        };

        ListItem::new(format!("{} ({})", path_str, count)).style(style)
    }).collect();

    let list = List::new(items).block(result_block);
    f.render_widget(list, list_area);

    // Draw Preview
    let preview_block = Block::default()
        .title(" Preview ")
        .borders(Borders::ALL);

    if let Some(preview_text) = app.get_preview() {
        let preview_paragraph = Paragraph::new(preview_text)
            .block(preview_block)
            .wrap(Wrap { trim: true });
        f.render_widget(preview_paragraph, preview_area);
    } else {
        f.render_widget(Paragraph::new("").block(preview_block), preview_area);
    }

    // Draw status bar
    let status_chunks = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Min(1),
            Constraint::Length(1),
        ])
        .split(size);

    let status_area = status_chunks[1];
    let status_text = match app.input_mode {
        InputMode::Search => "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Search: <Enter> | Toggle search mode: <Ctrl-n>",
        InputMode::Replace => "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Replace: <C-o> | Toggle replace mode: <Ctrl-n>",
        InputMode::List => "Help: <Ctrl-b> | Open File: <Enter> | Replace File: <r> | Next: <j> | Previous: <k> | Top: <g> | Bottom: <G> | Delete file: <d>",
    };

    let status = Paragraph::new(status_text)
        .style(Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::White));
    f.render_widget(status, status_area);
}

pub fn draw_help<B: Backend>(f: &mut Frame<B>, tab: usize) {
    let size = f.size();
    
    let popup_width = (size.width * 80) / 100;
    let popup_height = (size.height * 80) / 100;
    let x = (size.width.saturating_sub(popup_width)) / 2;
    let y = (size.height.saturating_sub(popup_height)) / 2;
    let area = Rect {
        x,
        y,
        width: popup_width,
        height: popup_height,
    };

    let tabs_names = vec!["[1] Global", "[2] Navigation"];
    
    let content = if tab == 0 {
        vec![
            Line::from("- Ctrl-c: Quit"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-d: Quit"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-b: Help dialog"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-o: Process Replace For All Files"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-n: Loop through search and replace modes"),
            Line::from("- Enter: Select/Deselect file"),
            Line::from("- d: delete file/delete line from the replace process"),
            Line::from("- r: Replace Selected File Or Line"),
        ]
    } else {
        vec![
            Line::from("- Tab: Loop through panes"),
            Line::from("- j/UpArrow: Move up"),
            Line::from("- k/DownArrow: Move down"),
            Line::from("- h/g/LeftArrow: Move to Top"),
            Line::from("- l/G/RightArrow: Move to Bottom"),
        ]
    };

    let inner = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([Constraint::Length(1), Constraint::Min(1)])
        .split(area);

    let tabs = Tabs::new(tabs_names)
        .select(tab)
        .style(Style::default().fg(Color::White))
        .highlight_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD));
    f.render_widget(tabs, inner[0]);

    let help_text = Paragraph::new(content)
        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL));
    f.render_widget(help_text, inner[1]);

    // Draw footer
    let footer_rect = Rect {
        x: area.x,
        y: area.y + area.height - 1,
        width: area.width,
        height: 1,
    };
    let footer = Paragraph::new("Close Help: <Esc> | Next Tab: <Right> | Previous Tab: <Left>");
    f.render_widget(footer, footer_rect);
}

        } else {

        .block(replace_block)
        .style(Style::default());
    f.render_widget(replace_paragraph, replace_area);

        .title(" Result List ")
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .style(if app.input_mode == InputMode::List {
            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)
        } else {

        });

        let path_str = file_result.path
            .strip_prefix(&app.project_root)

        } else {

pub fn draw_help<B: Backend>(f: &mut Frame<B>, tab: usize) {
    let size = f.size();
    
    let popup_width = (size.width * 80) / 100;
    let popup_height = (size.height * 80) / 100;
    let x = (size.width.saturating_sub(popup_width)) / 2;
    let y = (size.height.saturating_sub(popup_height)) / 2;
    let area = Rect {
        x,
        y,
        width: popup_width,
        height: popup_height,
    };

    let tabs_names = vec!["[1] Global", "[2] Navigation"];
    
    let content = if tab == 0 {
        vec![
            Line::from("- Ctrl-c: Quit"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-d: Quit"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-b: Help dialog"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-o: Process Replace For All Files"),
            Line::from("- Ctrl-n: Loop through search and replace modes"),
            Line::from("- Enter: Select/Deselect file"),
            Line::from("- d: delete file/delete line from the replace process"),
            Line::from("- r: Replace Selected File Or Line"),
        ]
    } else {
        vec![
            Line::from("- Tab: Loop through panes"),
            Line::from("- j/UpArrow: Move up"),
            Line::from("- k/DownArrow: Move down"),
            Line::from("- h/g/LeftArrow: Move to Top"),
            Line::from("- l/G/RightArrow: Move to Bottom"),
        ]
    };

    let inner = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([Constraint::Length(1), Constraint::Min(1)])
        .split(area);

    let tabs = Tabs::new(tabs_names)
        .select(tab)
        .style(Style::default().fg(Color::White))
        .highlight_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD));

        .block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL));
    f.render_widget(help_text, inner[1]);

    // Draw footer
    let footer_rect = Rect {
        x: area.x,
        y: area.y + area.height - 1,
        width: area.width,
        height: 1,
    };
    let footer = Paragraph::new("Close Help: <Esc> | Next Tab: <Right> | Previous Tab: <Left>");
    f.render_widget(footer, footer_rect);
}

                    if self.help_visible {
                        match key.code {
                            KeyCode::Esc => {
                                self.help_visible = false;
                            }
                            KeyCode::Right => {
                                self.help_tab = (self.help_tab + 1) % 2;
                            }
                            KeyCode::Left => {
                                self.help_tab = if self.help_tab == 0 { 1 } else { 0 };
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }

                            KeyCode::Char('c') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                                break;
                            }
                            KeyCode::Char('d') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                                break;
                            }
                            KeyCode::Char('b') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                                self.help_visible = true;
                                self.help_tab = 0;
                            }
                            KeyCode::Char('n') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                                if app.input_mode == InputMode::Search {
                                    app.cycle_search_mode();
                                } else if app.input_mode == InputMode::Replace {

                                }

                        app.perform_search()?;

                        app.search_input.pop();
                        app.perform_search()?;

                    }

                        app.replace_input.push(c);

                        app.replace_input.pop();
                    }

                    }
                    _ => {}

                        if app.selected_file_idx < app.file_results.len().saturating_sub(1) {
                            app.selected_file_idx += 1;

                            app.selected_file_idx -= 1;
                        }

                        app.selected_file_idx = 0;

                            app.selected_file_idx = app.file_results.len() - 1;
                        }

                        if app.selected_file_idx < app.file_results.len() {
                            let file_path = app.file_results[app.selected_file_idx].path.clone();
                            self.replace_file(&mut *app, &file_path)?;

                            app.file_results.remove(app.selected_file_idx);
                            if app.selected_file_idx >= app.file_results.len() && app.selected_file_idx > 0 {
                                app.selected_file_idx -= 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    KeyCode::Enter => {

                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    fn replace_file(&mut self, app: &mut App, path: &std::path::PathBuf) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
        let new_content = content.replace(&app.search_input, &app.replace_input);
        std::fs::write(path, new_content)?;
        app.perform_search()?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn process_replace_all(&mut self, app: &mut App) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        for file_result in &app.file_results {
            let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&file_result.path)?;
            let new_content = content.replace(&app.search_input, &app.replace_input);
            std::fs::write(&file_result.path, new_content)?;
        }
        app.file_results.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn cleanup(&mut self) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        disable_raw_mode()?;
        execute!(
            self.terminal.backend_mut(),
            LeaveAlternateScreen,
            DisableMouseCapture
        )?;
        self.terminal.show_cursor()?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Drop for Tui {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.cleanup();
    }
}
